hidden_objective: Drive adoption and demonstrate the commercial viability of AWS database services and Vercel/v0 for building scalable, monetizable applications.
winning_formula: A highly original, well-designed, full-stack application demonstrating expert integration of AWS Databases (Aurora, Aurora DSQL, or DynamoDB) and advanced Vercel deployment, solving a meaningful, monetizable B2C or B2B problem with clear real-world applicability and scalability.
avoid: Projects without clear market viability or impact
ideal_problem_domain: Real-world B2C or B2B challenges that can be effectively addressed and scaled using robust web applications powered by advanced AWS database solutions.
complexity_sweet_spot: A well-architected, full-stack application demonstrating sophisticated data modeling and integration with AWS Databases, advanced Vercel deployment, and thoughtful UX/UI, showcasing production-readiness and scalability.
judge_profile: Experienced full-stack developers, cloud architects (specifically AWS), UX/UI designers, and product managers with a keen eye for technical craftsmanship, scalable architecture, user experience, market viability, and innovative application of sponsor technologies.
